Compute performance of entering and exiting students

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
compute_entry_exit_performance.Rd

Identifies students who entered (present in year T but not T-1) or exited (present in year T-1 but not T) the tested population, then computes their mean scale score and percent proficient. Requires STUDENT_ID to track students across years.

Usage

compute_entry_exit_performance(
  data,
  direction = "entering",
  assessment_spec,
  by = c("YEAR", "SUBJECT"),
  min_n = 10
)

Arguments

data

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract). Must contain STUDENT_ID, YEAR, SCALE_SCORE, and (optionally) ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL.

direction

Character scalar: "entering", "exiting", or "both". Default "entering".

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

by

Character vector of grouping columns for performance statistics. Default c("YEAR", "SUBJECT").

min_n

Integer. Cells with fewer than min_n students have their statistics set to NA. Default 10.

Value

A data frame with columns: YEAR, group (entering/exiting), grouping columns from by, N, mean_score, pct_proficient, suppressed. Returns an empty data frame if STUDENT_ID is absent or fewer than 2 years are present.

Details

Presence is determined at the year level (a student is "present" in year T if they have at least one record in the data for that year, regardless of subject). For exiting students, performance statistics come from year T-1 (their last year of testing), but the row is labelled with YEAR = T (the transition year) so that entering and exiting rows align on the same YEAR axis in output tables.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
compute_entry_exit_performance(demo_data, direction = "both", assessment_spec)
} # }
